_comment: Reference list only — a starting point for what to search, NOT current prices or offers. Always verify live (see SKILL.md Step 2). Update this file occasionally as new providers/bundle types emerge.

mobile_carriers.name: T-Mobile
mobile_carriers.known_bundle_pattern: Historically bundles streaming perks (e.g. Netflix, Apple TV+, MLB.TV) into higher-tier unlimited plans. Verify current plan tier and included perk live.

mobile_carriers.name: Verizon
mobile_carriers.known_bundle_pattern: myPlan perks system lets customers add streaming perks (e.g. Disney Bundle, Netflix/Max) for a flat add-on price or free on top tiers. +play is Verizon's separate bundling storefront for third-party subscriptions. Verify current perk lineup live.

mobile_carriers.name: AT&T
mobile_carriers.known_bundle_pattern: Has periodically included streaming credits/bundles (e.g. HBO Max in the past) on unlimited plans, and DIRECTV STREAM bundle promos. Verify current offer live — this has changed multiple times.

stacking_categories: Student discounts (Spotify Premium Student often bundles Hulu; Amazon Prime Student)
Family/duo plan splitting for Spotify, YouTube Premium, Apple One
Credit card offer portals (Amex Offers, Chase Offers) for statement credits on streaming
Annual vs monthly billing discounts on individual services
Discounted gift cards at warehouse clubs (Costco, Sam's Club) for streaming/gift subscriptions
Apple One / Google One style first-party service bundles
